inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein is right that this needs a political resolution, but calls for one mean little when Israel pairs them with an “unwavering stance” and a continuing operation. Military pressure does not create lasting safety; it entrenches a system where those with the least power bear the greatest cost. Any real resolution must confront the structural inequality driving the conflict and protect Palestinians’ rights and security alongside everyone else’s. Endless escalation is not peace.
